messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — can someone clarify the timeline for additional GPU capacity in EMEA? We had a slide about Q3 provisioning but customers are asking for dates.
Asha: Short answer: Q3 still on track, but there are two parallel tracks — cloud partners (faster) and reserved on-prem racks (slower). We expect incremental A100/P4d slots via partners starting mid-August, bigger dedicated pools by end of Q3.
Priya: Helpful, thanks. Any guidance on which customers will be migrated to the new pools vs staying on existing clusters?
Miguel: Migration policy: prioritize Dedicated customers with SLA contracts, then high-throughput tenants. We’ll share a migration schedule next week. For hosted, routing will prefer nearest region but fallback rules remain the same.
Jesse: To add — product will publish an FAQ and a migration opt-out form. If a customer needs to stay pinned to current capacity for validation, they can request a delay.
Priya: Nice. Another question from support — are we changing autoscale cooldowns? We saw a couple of bursts where pods scaled down too quickly and caused cold-start latency.
Kai: Good catch. Ops has a short-term tweak rolling out: increase scale-down cooldown from 5m -> 12m for GPU pools with bursty traffic. Longer-term we're introducing warm standby replicas + smarter workload classification.
Priya: Any config snippet we can point customers to for recommended autoscale in Dedicated?
Kai: Yep — sharing recommended policy (internal):
```
policy: 
  min_replicas: 2
  target_utilization: 0.65
  scale_up_rate: 3x_per_min
  scale_down_cooldown: 12m
```
Priya: Perfect. One more — supply constraints: are we still relying on spot instances for cheap bursts, or moving toward committed capacity?
Miguel: Mix. For hosted API bursts we'll keep using spot/partner spare capacity where safe, but for Dedicated customers we’re pushing committed pools. Economic tradeoff: spot saves cost but increases risk of preemption; we'll use multi-tier routing to avoid visible degradation.
Asha: Also important — team is validating quantized model variants for some workloads to reduce GPU memory needs. That lets us serve more QPS per card without changing hardware.
Priya: That sounds promising. Timeline for quantized variants to be available in the catalog?
Miguel: Pilot next 3 weeks for small models; broader rollout in ~2 months. We’ll attach perf delta benchmarks so customers can decide.
Jesse: We'll coordinate doc updates and put a small banner in Console when regions or autoscale defaults change.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: config rollout started for scale-down cooldown tweak (env: prod-eu, change-id: cd-202503).
Priya: Thanks all — I'll consolidate answers and post a short follow-up in the all-hands thread for customers who were watching. :thumbsup:
